entries.zh: 工人在浮式干船坞内给船体刷漆。

entries.en: The wartime photograph showed a floating mine near the harbor.
entries.zh: 战时照片显示，港口附近有一枚浮动水雷。

entries.en: Each cargo shipment was declared under the floating policy.
entries.zh: 每批货运都按流动保单进行了申报。

entries.en: The manual printed the results in floating-point notation.
entries.zh: 手册用浮点计数法列出了结果。

entries.en: Rounding changed the last digit of the floating-point number.
entries.zh: 舍入改变了这个浮点数的最后一位数字。

entries.en: Smoke escaped through a crack in the flue pipe.
entries.zh: 烟从烟道排气管的一处裂缝中逸出。

entries.en: The restoration team removed the old fluid flywheel.
entries.zh: 修复团队拆下了旧液力飞轮。

entries.en: The bridge designer consulted a specialist in fluid mechanics.
entries.zh: 桥梁设计师请教了一位流体力学专家。
